For optimal care of mulberry trees (*Morus spp.*), provide full sun to encourage healthy growth and abundant fruit production. Maintain temperatures between 60-85°F (16-29°C) and moderate humidity, as these trees are adaptable to a wide range of climates. Use well-draining soil with a slightly acidic to neutral pH of 5.5-7.0. Water regularly, especially during dry periods, ensuring the soil remains consistently moist but not waterlogged. Fertilize in early spring and mid-summer with a balanced, slow-release fertilizer like 10-10-10 to support vigorous growth. Prune annually during the dormant season to shape the tree, remove dead or overcrowded branches, and promote airflow, which helps prevent diseases. With proper care, mulberry trees will reward you with a delicious harvest of sweet and juicy berries.
